newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: ARCON GETS NEW $85 MLN FACILITY FROM NATWEST.
newsitem.headline: ARCON GETS NEW $85 MLN FACILITY FROM NATWEST.

text.p: Arcon International Resources Plc said on Tuesday that NatWest Markets, the corporate and investment arm of the National Westminster Bank, had underwritten a new $85 million facility for the group.

"We are very pleased with this new facility ... it will considerably reduce lending rates and provide substantial resources for future investment opportunities," chief executive Tony O'Reilly said in a statement.
Arcon said the proceeds of this new facility would be used primarily to repay a limited resource project finance facility from NatWest.
NatWest Markets previously arranged a $60 million limited resource project financing facility which was used to finance the construction of the Arcon's Galmoy Mine in the Irish midlands.
The balance of the new facility would be made available for use by the Arcon group to strengthen its balance sheet and to invest in mining/mineral opportunities, it said.
